name: Disposable Hearts
source:
Myha and Iris are two soldiers aka "divers" who have the mission of retrieving valuable materials and going back home. Follow them while they try to survive and search for something worth fighting for in this hostile and vile world reigned by corporations.

[From [url=https://teatimestudio.itch.io/disposable-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
